traits.fruit_surface.note: Anderson, The Cactus Family (2001) p. 486, Opuntia: pericarpel globose to top-shaped with areoles and leafy scales, no floral tube; the fruit a berry; O. gosseliniana (p. 501) spineless with many glochids.

traits.note: Britton and Rose's The Cactaceae (vol. 1, 1919, pp. 44 to 45 and 99), as their subgenus Platyopuntia, the prickly pears, today's Opuntia: joints flattened, their spines without sheaths; the areoles sit on the joint's face, not on tubercles.
